oneLine: Brookfield acquires ESR India logistics portfolio for Rs 4,300 crore.

sources.title: Brookfield enters India logistics realty market with Rs 4,300-cr ESR portfolio deal
Brookfield enters Indian logistics with 10.5 million sq ft ESR portfolio buyout
Brookfield to acquire ESR India’s industrial and logistics portfolio

synopsis: Global alternative investment major Brookfield has acquired a 10.5 million sq ft logistics portfolio from ESR India for Rs 4,300 crore or $450 million, committing funds towards the transaction and future development of the portfolio. This marks Brookfield's foray into India's industrial and logistics real estate market by acquiring a 100% interest in the portfolio. ESR will continue to manage the properties in the near term. Spread across more than 400 acres in six metro clusters, the portfolio comprises eight Grade A parks across major gateway cities including Mumbai, Pune, Delhi NCR, Chennai and Kolkata, with the operating portfolio being 98% leased.
